notes.title: DESOLATIUM will be a part of Lovecraftian Days this April!
notes.content:
Hello, cultists! 

Today, we've got some big updates to share about DESOLATIUM that you don't want to miss. 

First things first, the Steam page of DESOLATIUM is now available in [b]19 different languages[/b]! This means that you can now explore all the features and thrills this Lovecraftian horror title has to offer in your own language, whether it be French, German, Spanish, Dutch, Japanese, and many others! 

But that's not all! We're thrilled to announce that DESOLATIUM will be a part of this year's [b]Lovecraftian Days on Steam[/b]! Join us from [b]April 4 to April 8, 2024[/b], at this special event for all cosmic horror fans. During this time, you can take advantage of a limited-time discount offer and catch a glimpse of the gameplay with our partnered streamers and content creators.

 [previewyoutube=h35hsCwaR90;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Add it to your wishlist today! [/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1474900/DESOLATIUM/

notes.title: Desolatium Devlog - September
notes.content:
Hello cultists! It's already October and that means two things:(late) september devlog and best month of the year!

Desolatium is almost over, but as you know we will keep you posted with everything Soedesco announces! Here’s few things we’ve worked on this past months:

[h3]360 PHOTOS – SKY[/h3]
Yes, 360 photos are real, but not all the elements! We changed almost all of the skies to create a more accurate athmosphere. Some of them kind of remind us to the prologue, don’t they? But just in some chapters, you’ll discover soon!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39156286/436b70f4ceb19b9032137f36259daf78b2fc90f8.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39156286/ebf7a0a7701c6cec822e29b2641a93b24ab6468a.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39156286/1c33ce7f9a975cca13a6ca5a2b9488786359be67.jpg[/img]
 
[h3]MOTION GRAPHICS[/h3]
We needed some extra videos to explain the story. They refere to the past, showing memories or flashbacks. Here’s an example and its storyboard! (We chose one with no spoilers!)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39156286/b647067e604fb41070690ac6e7870bd79d126d33.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39156286/a939161bb48fbf9ffa24d44b8e7b23ad9f3b2b2e.gif[/img]

[h3]PUZZLES[/h3]
Yes, we love symbols so you will find many in the game: not only on the walls but also in puzzles! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39156286/66e5f6f0d99de79e656377ac83a8db1762e61792.jpg[/img]
 
[h3]GHOUL[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39156286/c5f40ea9d07131ce6a25f1e1dad179109c50b7fb.jpg[/img]
 
[h3]FIXING BUGS[/h3]
Once you think the game is finished, bugs say hi… And here’s what we have been focusing on the most. Working to give you the best posible experience! (Also we have more to tell about what we've been working on, but we have to keep quiet!)

And that’s all! Stay tuned because this is our favourite month (Halloween time) and we have a little surprise for you 

notes.title: Monthly Desolatium Devlog - August
notes.content:
Hello cultists! Summer is already over and now it’s time to get back to normal. As you know from last devlog, this has been a crazy summer for us, as many important things happened and changed, and now we can finally tell: 

[b]The Dutch Publisher [url=https://www.soedesco.com/]SOEDESCO [/url]has bought us! [/b] Those who have brought us Kaze and the Wild Mask or Owlboy have seen something special in SUPERLUMEN and have totally acquired us: game and company.[b] So… what about Desolatium?[/b]

This will of course imply changes, since from now on it will be SOEDESCO and the great team behind it who will guide us, [b]setting new times and dates for both the development and the publication[/b] of Desolatium. And this can only bring good things: now that we are 100% focused on DESOLATIUM, without any extra project and with SOEDESCO in charge, promise (and we will keep it) the best DESOLATIUM for you.

Now that you know what changed these months, let’s move on to the development update! 

[h2]SUBTITULES[/h2]
As you suggested, we are adding subtitles to every voiceover. Desolatium will be translated into 25 languages, so big work here!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39156286/3161165594214c655020244f05d1412669503e6d.png[/img]

[h2]360 PHOTOS[/h2]
Some small modifications are still being made in the 360 photos, this is an example, but many more are ready! 
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39156286/8e289c49ce960411f689aef3fcb57e695bb2fd82.jpg[/img]

[h2]PUZZLES[/h2]
Almost all the puzzles have been designed and are being programmed!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39156286/2d1e121844ae14fc8eedfb611b5a95ee7fe96435.jpg[/img]
 
[h2]MOTION GRAPHICS + VIDEO[/h2]
Here’s the storyboard for one of the motion graphics we’re preparing and one video from an important scene we can’t reveal!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39156286/726ff2846c80f7939d71cbe603eb0894f101bea8.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39156286/e1a378362afb2e8d11a99aa0f9adb3bc1b397e58.gif[/img] 

And that’s all! Here are us working hard but accompanied by the best ones: H.P. Lovecraft and our protagonists in Desolatium ;)

notes.title: Monthly Desolatium Devlog - June
notes.content:
Greetings Cultists!

Summer is already here, so we hope you have plenty of time to discover new games and finally play the ones you have on your library! (Easier said than done ːsteammockingː )

For us, not much is changing this summer, we keep working on the development as we are approaching the final stretch! So here is our monthly update to provide you with inside information on what has been happening in the development of Desolatium:

[h2]NEW OBJECTS[/h2]

We included new objects in some chapters, so we’re back there adding them! Here Christopher is investigating thoroughly…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39156286/4e5678431f4de4a17398a8fdf84409be08041d0b.png[/img]

[h2]DIALOGUES[/h2]
 
All dialogues are ready! Even the ones from the big final chapter. Sorry for the blurry, but no spoilers are allowed here ;)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39156286/2c5342c7c3ac2e88f3e160b86bad6dcee8fab5e3.png[/img]

[h2]ART[/h2]

One of the things our artist designer enjoys the most, is creating the posters of each chapter. Sometimes it’s really difficult to choose one, we honestly love all the designs se does. Here are the three options for chapter 5, which one would be your choice?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39156286/ddb679fe30755c8f68ba67fb15b522874585d696.jpg[/img]
 
And here is the most important poster, the one from the final chapter! At least a part of it, we don’t want to reveal it yet ;)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39156286/81e34114ad153f7da35544a7505a8d0cf1761bfa.gif[/img]

[h2]360º IMAGES[/h2]

As you have probably seen in other devlogs, we take 360º photos to generate all the levels. In march we showed you some pics of a shooting in Toledo (close to Madrid, Spain), and here is the result! (Still many things missing, this is only the image edited). Are you able to find where the big glass table with chairs is located in the scene?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39156286/bc6ee6fd2b7a12d9090cf5a77e943308411dce80.png[/img]

[h2]CHARACTERS[/h2]
We finished the characters a while ago, but we still like to show you one new character every month! Here's the Lighthouse Keeper:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39156286/ea79d669f53656ab4d7e1b9582937289e2f734a9.gif[/img]

We would love to show you more, but we don’t want to reveal everything! You will have to wait until next month for more insights ;)

notes.title: DESOLATIUM DEMO UPDATE - Patch Notes v1.02
notes.content:
Greeting cultists!

We start the weekend with good news: [b]New Desolatium Demo patch is now live![/b]

While we continue with the development of Desolatium, we have taken the time to make some improvements to the current demo: so update the game for the following 

[h2]Patch Notes [/h2]

[list]
[*] We have replaced one of the NPCs with the definitive one.
[*] We have added the option to adjust the volume (music and voices), plus some new sounds.
[*] Fixed some transitions
[*] We have better integrated some notes in the scenes.
[/list]

You can check some of the improvements in our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1474900/view/3197000290669324563]March devlog[/url] or by playing the demo (we recommend the second option ːsteammockingː).

We want to [b]hear your feedback,[/b] so please use the Steam comments to leave your impressions and help us improve the final game. [b]Until then, we will keep working and praying to the Dark and Primeval Gods.[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1474900/Desolatium/


[i]"But remember that dark world of fungoid gardens and windowless cities isn't really terrible. It is only to us that it would seem so. Probably this world seemed just as terrible to the beings when they first explored it in the primal age. You know they were here long before the fabulous epoch of Cthulhu was over, and remember all about sunken R'lyeh when it was above the waters”
The Whisperer In Darkness, The Haunter Of The Dark – H. P. Lovecraft
[/i]

notes.title: Devlog March - Desolatium
notes.content:
Greeting cultists!

As every month, here is our devlog! A way to bring you closer to the development of Desolatium.
March has been great! We have made great progress in the development and we will show you some [b]things to highlight[/b] from this past moth: 

[h2][b]360 PHOTOS[/b][/h2]

Some of the scenes were missing, such as the secret [b]Theron Marks Society[/b] room. We still hadn’t found the perfect scenario for that location, but we finally did in [b]Toledo[/b], a small town close to Madrid, 4 hours away from our living city. 

[i]Fun fact: we finally got to meet Isabel, the only one in our team who works remotely in another city: The one in charge of the Art in Desolatium![/i]

Here are some of the[b] behind the scenes[/b] pics! (You will love this scene in the game, specially when you see the transformation)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39156286/b3e16a679378361ecacf946eeb00bddd0f73e58f.png[/img]

[h2][b]ART AND DESIGN[/b][/h2]

We keep working on the [b]detail views[/b] of the things you will need to find: notes, objets, clues… Here’s one of them: a drawer with a note and an old book inside. [b]What will they be needed for?[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39156286/e8a1745fbd1992559eafc3bf07f434258307cfc5.gif[/img]

We have also [b]colour-graded and edited [/b]more images, like this street: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39156286/cf63dd4d9306d81844ac4ed583277a250162536f.png[/img]

And[b] added some elements[/b] to other images. We needed more chaos so we added some books and blood in this library:
  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39156286/f8b17a1f6bac9f24ac6c1ca17cdb608184bebe5a.png[/img]

[h2][b]DEMO[/b][/h2]

As we told you last month, we have been working on a [b]new update [/b]of the demo, these are some of the [b]changes [/b]you will be able to see:

[list]
[*] [b]Idd Yahh[/b] wasn’t ready when we released the demo, but she is now! So we have replaced her in the scene:
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39156286/42682f9d9db7bdcbe623b8d4d70559cb16a46e9c.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Here you will be able to control the [b]music and sound effects[/b], one of the things we have been asked for the most!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39156286/a73a90c323cd41dc3d6fb8930cec9a416a01e177.png[/img]

You will have to play to discover the rest of the improvements, but we will tell you more about it in our next post here in Steam, so stay tuned!!

And that wraps it up! Make sure that you're up to date by following our socials for Desolatium related news! Check out our links here:

notes.title: Dev Log – February
notes.content:
Greetings Cultists!

Here is our[b] monthly update[/b] to provide you with inside information on what has been happening in the [b]development of Desolatium.[/b]

February has been short but intense! So many new cultists here from The Big Adventure Event and Steam Next Event, so we want to thank you for your interest in Desolatium and bring you closer to its development.

After all of your feedback, we decided to[b] update the demo[/b] with things you suggested, so this month we continued with the development of next chapters, but also we’ve been fixing all the bugs and adding some features to the demo.

[b]So here are the main things to highlight from February:[/b]

[b]Design:[/b]

- Designed the missing graphic material from chapter 6: pointers, hovers, and some objects. Chapter 6 is now ready!
- Finished all the graphic material of the dialogues in chapter 7: texts, face images, titles...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39156286/c37f26c0237b167a910be53fc7f396cdf767edb1.png[/img]

- Created and designed more different posters for the beginning of each chapter.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39156286/62918d26c9ce020ca51aaeba59cdf16f70461cbb.jpg[/img]

[b]3D Characters:[/b]

- One of the things that took us the longest this month, was the character rendering: hours and hours to finally have the characters ready to implement them in the different scenes in the game. Here is our barman! From concept art to final 3D model. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39156286/59f845f3af95f835e5be9309e6649b403f04704a.png[/img]

- We have retouched the animation of some characters in blender.
- Created the video, the mask and then integrated it in the scene.

[b]Puzzles:[/b]

- Edited some widgets of the puzzles with buttons.
- Created the detail view image from some puzzles. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39156286/07b0cfbff304e4d1a6d99d551997867e86c535ae.png[/img]

[b]Sound:[/b]

- Prepared and integrated sounds from chapter 6 and 7.

[b]Demo bugs and features: [/b]

- Fixed some transitions between screens
- Added some sounds (such as steps or door sounds) and replaced others.
- Better integrated notes on the scene
- Fixed some sounds and voices: now you can adjuste the volumen!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39156286/8695b84132834b4ff41580730bbed5129fb6a59d.png[/img]

And that wraps it up! Make sure that you're up to date by following our socials fore Desolatium related news! Check out our links here:

notes.title: Dev live stream and new demo update for Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
Dear cultists, 

As we told you in our last post, we’re happy to see that many of you have played and enjoyed the Desolatium demo. We’ve been watching you on Youtube and Twitch,[b] hearing your suggestions[/b] and [b]reading your comments[/b] and we have some good news: we will release another demo update soon.

We’ve [b]fixed some bugs[/b] and [b]added features and tweaks [/b]that were suggested by those of you who gave the demo a try:

[list]
[*] Fixed some transitions between screens
[*] Added some sounds (such as steps or door sounds) and replaced others.
[*] Better integrated notes on the scene
[*] Fixed some sounds and voices: now you can adjuste the volumen!
[/list]

There are a few more small changes, but these are the highlights. Thank you for all of your feedback, it’s been invaluable!

We will tell you more about the new updates in our [b]live stream for Steam Next Fest friday 7pm CEST.[/b] But we won't be alone! Raziel317 will join us! He will be commenting, chatting with us, and asking some interesting things about the game. See you there?

If you haven't convinced yourself to jump into the Desolatium Demo yet, come and watch us! And of course, if you played and you have any more feedback, feel free to post it on the Steam forums, or join us on Discord!

notes.title: Dev Log - December
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39156286/92b8d05f32bce272eedb653af1c75668a9994679.png[/img]

Greetings Cultists!

First of all, we hope you’re spending your Christmas holidays in the best possible way! We wish you a [b]Happy New Year,[/b] we are sure that 2022 will bring us many good things, one of them will be [b]Desolatium[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39156286/7b7cea4ce233f76322e595fab4d3fd5a72d0933c.jpg[/img]

We wanted to end the year with something [b]special[/b], so that’s why we released a [b]new demo[/b] which you all are now able to play. 

But apart from the demo, we’ve been working hand-in-hand with our ghouls to keep developing Desolatium.

You have been gathered here by the old ones to reveal his prophecies! This month we have been working around programming, design and sound further polishing the existing content and adding more. 

As the new demo is already out, which means the first two chapters are done, we have been working on the next ones (third and fourth chapter mostly), and this is what we’ve been up to:

[b]PROGRAMMING[/b]
- Set up the scenes with inventory elements, advance, triggers, sounds, etc.
- Detail view and puzzles [luminol]

[b]DESIGN[/b]
- Characters concept art [Mask men, Idh-yaa]
- Grading 360 images.
- Notes design
- Objects design

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39156286/302e87f65622f12343109fe7a490933ca0eee7af.png[/img]

[b]LEVEL DESIGN[/b]
- Place mobile sound.
- Place objects in the scene.
-  Gearch for the location of the guard station.

[b]3D[/b]
- Fire scene

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39156286/4b23f419f1c5f34dac993d53961f57a0fd11d654.jpg[/img]

[b]SOUND[/b]
- VFX sounds: mobile, fire, luminol...
- Create gameplay.

And that wraps it up! We're planning more surprises in the future so make sure that you're up to date by following our socials fore Desolatium related news! Check out our links here: [url=https://twitter.com/desolatium]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/desolatium/]Facebook[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/desolatium/]Instagram[/url], [url=https://discord.gg/7aWduhP]Discord[/url] and our [url=https://superlumen.es/]Superlumen Website[/url].

We would be so grateful if you would also [b]wishlist [/b]us on steam if you haven't already!

See you in Carcossa,

The Superlumen Team

notes.title: Dev Log - November
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39156286/19a8dda870288f6a465950fa44871680d05322c6.png[/img]

Greetings Cultists!

Here is our monthly update to provide you with inside information on what has been happening in the development of Desolatium! We have been play testing our demo version to make sure that the demo experience will be smooth to our players. We've also taken into consideration some different feedback from our playtesters, and applied some changes. We also did our usual bug hunt rounds and fixed most of what we found.

[b]Here's what we did in the first week of November:[/b]
[list]
[*] Color grading all chapter 2 images.
[*] Find and fix bugs on chapter 1.
[*] Record all voice-overs Chapter 2.
[*] Narrative review and level design of Chapter 1. (voice overs, translations, notes, flashbacks, etc.)
[/list][b]In our second week, we mostly updated and added concept art for all of the characters in-game.[/b]

[b]Concept Art Chapter 1:[/b][list]
[*] Carter's inventory (Uni teacher).
[*] Sophie's inventory (Uni teacher).
[*] Jame's inventory (researcher).
[*] Christopher's inventory (journalist). 
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39156286/333f7d1f52bffac17b48234ca1e8a9b9b63411e4.jpg[/img]

[b]Concept Art Chapter 2:[/b]
[list]
[*] Design scene 01 of Sophie's poster.
[*] Design notes of the scene.
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39156286/811b9379df466aa0a817b44c1039cf6ece9258cf.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Dev log - October
notes.content:
Greetings Cultists!

We have been silent for quite a while, and we wanted to apologize for that! We are hard at work with developing Desolatium and moving forward, we would like to provide you with detailed updates on the development of the game. Since June, we have been applying constant improvements, making sure that the final copy will be a worthy offering to [i]Cthulhu[/i] and our players.

[b]JUNE[/b]
[list]
[*] We finished the script, including all texts, dialogues, notes, etc.[/list]
[b]JULY[/b][list]
[*] New Identity design.
[*] Defined the style of the dialogues, notes, puzzles and motion graphics.
[*] Concept design of scenarios in game.
[*] Shooting on location (360 images and videos).
[*] Created the project in the Engine and started to design the architecture of the code.[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39156286/b873c7ef25ed3cd8004c90a08e3fad7b2cb7fd35.jpg[/img]

[b]AUGUST[/b][list]
[*] Art design of the game.
[*] Shooting on location (360 images and videos).
[*] Characters design (2D and 3D).
[*] Post-processing of every picture and video before and in UE4 to create the atmosphere, add elements, dynamic content, and NPCs using 3D elements.
[*] Finished the document with the code architecture.
[*] Starting to develop the game and the structure, based on the project “Desolatium: prologue”.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39156286/ccaa7a206190a2164f425b5fe2404da17357e87e.jpg[/img]

[b]SEPTEMBER[/b]
[list]
[*] Menu design (start and in game).
[*] Added subtitles.
[*] Defining sound style: We have been working with Xabi San Martin for the sound style of the game. 
[*] As for the art, we want something different to the rest of the Lovecraftian games and we are working on it with Xabi as well.
[*] Design: Objects, Notes, Inventory.
[*] For the main menu, we have to think of how to mix everything in one screen, and also program some of the settings such as managing FOV, and Mouse Sensibility.
[*] Created widgets.
[*] Developing the inventory part of the game (objects and notes), puzzles and all the things from the level design document.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39156286/835e58e269dde15f2daf5ac2ffe147f700425432.png[/img]

[b]OCTOBER[/b]
[list]
[*] We had some problems with the lighting of the 3D models and objects. We need to use a different light for  the background to make it more realistic.
[*] We changed the note system. In this new system, the notes are managed as objects so they need their own inventory, this allows players to consult them at any time.
[*] Development of the new inventory. We had to unify the inventory and the notes together.
[*] Design and implementation of the flashbacks display. We have had to put in a lot of work with post-processing, and the sound system of UE to get the effect we wanted.
[*] Voice recording (English and Spanish).
[*] Developing the main menu (settings), menu in-game and language selector.
[*] Fixed some bugs in chapter 1.
[*] Desolatium Demo is now ready.
[/list]
And that is it for now! We plan on doing this every month moving forward, so make sure to keep an eye out for our next dev log update!

Follow us on our socials for all the up to date news! Check out our links here: [url=https://twitter.com/desolatium]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/desolatium/]Facebook[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/desolatium/]Instagram[/url], [url=https://discord.gg/7aWduhP]Discord[/url] and our [url=https://superlumen.es/]Superlumen Website[/url].

We would be so grateful if you would also wishlist us on steam if you haven't already!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39156286/7b0bd715d7881fd3a8d73f32a1683d89aff84242.png[/img]

See you in Carcossa,

The Superlumen Team

notes.title: DESOLATIUM: PROLOGUE AVAILABLE NOW
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39156286/ecd229e51e6a2a21d1632b1c05ca00ac89ed3418.png[/img]

Hello cultists!

A few months ago we came up with the idea of making a shorter game, while we keep developing DESOLATIUM, in order to make the wait more bearable. And this is how DESOLATIUM: PROLOGUE was born.

It was at first published on Steam for our backers to try it and thanks to their feedback, we developed a new and improved version.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39156286/e8a0f8157ba99c6f7e34a67f0dac4a35315e8eb0.png[/img]

[h1]WHAT’S ABOUT?[/h1]

We have always believed that God sent his son into the world to save us. But, what if that is not what happened? What if the world cannot be saved? The real story is about to be revealed.

You will explore a city outside the limits of time and space; meet mysterious characters who will guide you on your journey; interact with the objects around you to solve complex puzzles in order to get to the terrible presence of a cosmic entity of immense power: Cthulhu.

The time has come to answer the call of The Great Dreamer.

[h1]FEATURES:[/h1]

[list]
[*] [b]Hyper-realistic graphics:[/b] All levels have been generated by shooting real locations in 360º and the integration of 3D elements in post-production.
[*] [b]Graphic point & click adventure[/b] full of mystery.
[*] [b]Ambisonic Audio (8D):[/b] It generates an immersive sound effect that seems to come from all around the player. You will only need your headphones to live this experience.
[*] [b]Full immersion[/b]: Desolatium: Prologue is available for PC/MAc and, if you want to achieve total immersion, you are able to use a Virtual Reality device (Steam and Oculus).
[/list]

[h1]WHAT WILL I FIND?[/h1]

[list]
[*]  Inventory: You will be able to combine objects in order to create new ones.
[*]  Dialogue: From now on, you will have the possibility to talk with other characters.
[*]  Cinematic scene: Made using motion graphics.
[*]  Design: New designs for the game interface that will immerse you even more in the adventure.
[*]  New enemies with new animations.
[*]  Puzzles: more complex riddles you will have to solve.
[*]  Lore: Many more references, both to the universe created by Lovecraft and to other horror classics.
[*]  Music and effects: The experience will be improved thanks to the great Xabi San Martín, who has created new melodies for this prologue.
[/list]

DESOLATIUM: PROLOGUE ON STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1640540/Desolatium_Prologue/
